s: Shehaiqqar poter et hattapel, ubo y"a seipim: kol shehu iqqar veimmo tepela — mebarek al haiqqar upoter et hattepela, ben mibberaka rishona ben mibberaka acharona. En tzarik lomar im hattepela meorebet im haiqqar, kegon kol taarobet shene minim shehaechad hu iqqar vehashsheni eno ella letaqqeno ulehakshiro, o apillu shenehem iqqar ella shehaechad merubbeh vehaechad muat, sheharob nechshab iqqar vehammuat tapel, o betaarobet mammashut dagan, sheapillu hu muat nechshab iqqar. Vaapillu eno meorab mammash im hattapel, ella shennaasa al daat leekol shenehem yachad, kegon issa memullet beperot, veaz apillu okel hattapel lebaddo achar shebberak al haiqqar — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek. Ella apillu enan meorabin kelal zeh im zeh, ella sheiqqar haakila hu mimmin echad vehashsheni eno ba ella mechamat harishon, sheim lo haya okel harishon lo haya okelo kelal atta, hare hu tapel elayv veniptar bebirkato, apillu hu lechem, shehu chashub mikkol hamminim, kegon mi shechapetz leekol dag maluach ukede shello yazziqennu bigrono okel immo pat — hare hu tepela laddag venipteret bebirkato. Vehu sheeno raeb veeno taeb kelal laakilat happat, velo haya okelo kelal akshav im lo hammaliach, abal im hu taeb gam laakilat pat, ap al pi sheokelo im hammaliach — enah tepela elayv, apillu im taeb lo yoter, vetzarik lebarek aleha "hammotzi" upoter et hammaliach, hoil vehu middebarim sheddarkan labo tok hasseuda, shehem niptarim leolam bebirkat happat, ap sheenam baim mechamatah, kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"z:

Veken mi sheokel lipne seuda pat sheruya beyen sarap, ap al pi sheiqqar kavvanato bazeh al hayyen sarap, ella mippene shehu chazaq veqasheh lo lishtoto lebaddo shoreh bo pat veokelo, mikkol maqom, kevan shehu lipne hasseuda vadday kavvanato gam ken lisod halleb, ulepikak en happat tepela lehayyen sarap, vetzarik lebarek aleha "hammotzi", upoter et hayyen sarap apillu en kavvanato bo kede leorer taavat hammaakal, shello haya niptar bebirkat happat im haya shotehu bipne atzmo, kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"d. Veken apillu im shoreh pat beyayin shetztzarik lebarek alayv "bore peri haggapen" ap betok hasseuda — en tzarik lebarek al habbalua bappat hashsheruya bo, shekkevan shekkavvanato gam ken lisod halleb — happat iqqar vehayyayin tapel, shekkol taarobet min dagan im min acher — haddagan iqqar leolam, kol shemmitkavvenin gam ken laakilato, ap al pi sheiqqar hakkavvana hu bishbil min haacher, kemo shennitbaer besiman r"ch:

Ulepikak, apillu pat habbaa bekisanin shemmebarek aleha "bore mine mezonot", im shoreh otah beyayin o yen sarap ushear mashqin — en tzarik lebarek al mashqeh habbalua bah, velo al mashqeh sheal gabbah, kegon shemmetabbel bidbash veokel, vaapillu im iqqar kavvanato al hammashqeh (shekkevan shehi meHashem minim hi iqqar). Ella im ken eno mitkavven laakilatam kelal, ella kede shello yetannepu et hayyadayim mehaddebash, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"ch, o shoreh beyen sarap vekavvanato al hayyen sarap bilbad, ella shemmippene shehu chazaq veqasheh lo lishtoto lebaddo hu shoreh bo pat veokelah, ap al pi sheeno mitavveh lah kelal, kegon mi sheshshoreh achar hasseuda meat pat beyen sarap veokelah leakkel hammaakal, sheaz naaset happat tepela layyen sarap, vetzarik lebarek aleha "shehakkol", kedin yen sarap habba leakkel hammaakal, kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"d. (Veim shoreh bo maakal shemmitavveh lo veeno mechameshet hamminim — banu lammachaloqet shennitbaer besiman r"b, sheyyesh omerim shekkol taarobet b' minim sheechad mehem haya okelo gam illu haya lebaddo vehashsheni lo haya okelo lebaddo — naasa zeh tapel lazeh hoil veeno okelo ella al yede shemmeorab [ba]zeh, veap al pi shekkavvanato al shenehem beshaveh. Veyesh choleqim bazeh. Usepeq berakot lehaqel, kemo shennitbaer sham):

Vaapillu im mitkavven umitavveh litom happat hashsheruya bammashqeh, ella sheeno oseh laakila ella lishtiyya, kegon shemmeparer lechem daq daq venoten letok shekar cham kede sheyyitten bo taam, kevan sheen ballechem mammashut vedabar chashub — hashshekar iqqar (shello ameru shekkol taarobet sheyyesh bo dagan haddagan iqqar, ella kesheyyesh bo mammashut haddagan, velo ribba bo mashqeh harbeh ad shennaasa rak verauy lishtiyya ella hu ab verauy laakila, kemo shennitbaer besiman r"ch):

Vekol zeh bepat o maakal acher sheokel im hammaliach o im hayyen sarap beyachad, abal mah sheokel achar kak lebaddo — tzarik lebarek alayv techilla vasop, kevan shebbaakila zo enennu tapel kelal, vegam mittechilla lo naasa tapel ella bishat akilato otam yachad, velo mittechillat asiyyatam yachad baapiyya o bishshul, sheal yede zeh naasu kedabar echad mammash libraka, leinyan shehaiqqar poter et hattapel ap im okelo achar kak lebad (abal lo leinyan sheyyebarek al hattapel birkat haiqqar im ba leoklo lebaddo mittechilla, mittaam sheyyitbaer). Veim gam baakila zo hu tapel — en tzarik lebarek alayv ap al pi sheokelo lebaddo, kegon mi sheokel pat lematteq hashshetiyya sheshshata kebar — en tzarik lebarek aleha, shehi tepela lammashqeh venipteret bebirkato:

Vekol pat shehi tepela leinyan beraka — hi tepela gam ken leinyan netilat yadayim, veen tzarik littol yadayv, apillu okel kebetza. Vetob limnoa milleekol pat lematteq hashshetiyya, ki mi yukal lehabchin im okelah lematteq hashshetiyya o lemilluy keres, sheaz tzarik lebarek aleha "hammotzi":

Vekol zeh bemittuq hashshetiyya sheshshata kebar, abal haokel garine gudg[da]niyyot vekayyotze bahem lematteq hashshetiyya sheyyishteh, sheakilatam goreret lo taava lishtiyya, ap al pi sheakilatam tepela lehashshetiyya vehayeta nipteret bebirkatah im haya okel achar shebberak al hashshetiyya, mikkol maqom, kesheokel qodem hashshetiyya i epshar sheyyippater bebirkat hashshetiyya sheyyebarek achar akilato, ki asur lehanot mehaolam hazzeh belo beraka battechilla, laken tzarik lebarek alehem beraka hamyuchedet lahem. Veken harotzeh lishtot babboqer o achar shenat tzohorayim, verotzeh leekol meat techilla kede shello yishteh al leb reqan, ap al pi sheakila zo hi tzorek hashshetiyya utepela eleha — tzarik lebarek aleha beraka hamyuchedet lah, kede shello yehaneh mehaolam hazzeh belo beraka:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheshshoteh yayin shebbirkato "bore peri haggapen", shei epshar lebarek beraka zo al hammaakal, abal hashshoteh mashqeh shebbirkato "shehakkol" — yesh omerim sheyyebarek al hammaakal sheokel techilla "shehakkol" velo birkato hamyuchedet lo, shekkevan sheakilato enah ella letzorek hashshetiyya utepela eleha — mebarek aleha birkat hashshetiyya shehi iqqar. Abal kol tapel sheen akilato tepela el haiqqar ella kesheokel shenehem yachad o hattapel achar haiqqar, ukesheokelo qodem haiqqar en akilato tepela elayv kelal, kegon shehebiu elayv pat o maakal acher leekol im hammaliach shello yazziqennu bigrono o lematteq hashshetiyya achar sheyyishteh, ukeshebba leekol mimmennu lipne hammaliach o lipne hashshetiyya en akila zo tepela eleha kelal — tzarik lebarek aleha beraka hamyuchedet lah velo birkat hammaliach o hammashqeh, ap al pi shehi "shehakkol". Lepikak, tob sheyyokal mimmennu meat qodem birkat hammaliach o hammashqeh, kede sheyyebarek alayv beraka hamyuchedet lo, velo yipterennu bibraka acheret betorat tepela. Veap al pi shemmin haddin en lachosh lekak, sheap shebbirkat haiqqar hi "shehakkol" shehi beraka kolelet ubirkat hattepela hi beraka meboreret uporetet — en lah din qedima al haiqqar, kevan sheeno okel atta hattapel ella bishbil akilat haiqqar, im ken qodem shehitchil baakilat haiqqar sheadayin eno chapetz leekol hattapel — eno mechuyyab leoklo bishbil qedimat birkato, kemo shennitbaer besiman ry"a, mikkol maqom kevan shehaiqqar vehattapel en birkotehem shavot, veim yebarek al haiqqar techilla lo yebarek kelal al hattapel, veim yebarek al hattapel techilla yachazor vibarek al haiqqar — tob yoter laasot ken, leharbot babberakot, ki leolam yarbeh haadam babberakot hatztzerikot vimaet besheenan tzerikot, vezo hi beraka hatztzerika, shehare hi meyuchedet lehattapel velo lehaiqqar, vegam (be)birkat haiqqar enah meyuchedet el hattapel ella kolelet gam et hattapel, velo tzivvu lemaet ella kesheyyakol liptor shene debarim bibraka achat hamyuchedet lishnehem:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheen haiqqar chabib lo yoter mehattapel, ella shehashshaa tzerika lekak laasot mimmennu iqqar, kegon sheakal kebar perot metuqin beyoter vehutzrak leekol acharehem maliach lechattek hallechot hanniqbatzot baitztomeka, veokel immo ezeh maakal shello yazziqennu bigrono, abal en hammaliach chabib alayv veeno mitavveh lo kelal, kemo sheeno mitavveh lehammaakal akshav im lo hammaliach. O apillu im haiqqar chabib alayv akshav, ella shebberob happeamim hattapel chabib alayv yoter, veim ken en qedima lehaiqqar, kemo shennitbaer besiman ry"a. Veen tzarik lomar im gam akshav hattapel chabib alayv yoter, ella sheap al pi ken lo haya okelo im lo shehutzrak leekol hammaliach, umippene zeh hu tapel elayv. Veap sheap al pi ken en tzarik lehaqdim hattapel min haddin ap al pi shehu chabib, kevan shello haya okelo kelal im lo haiqqar, mikkol maqom, kede leharbot babberakot — tob lehaqdimo, kevan sheen lehaiqqar din qedima mitztzad atzmo. Veap im mitztzad birkato yesh lo din qedima, kegon shebbirkato "bore peri haadama" o "bore peri haetz" ubirkat hattapel hi "shehakkol", mikkol maqom, kevan sheim yebarek al haiqqar techilla "bore peri haetz" o "bore peri haadama" lo yebarek kelal al hattapel shebbirkato "shehakkol nihya bidbaro" — lo shayyak kelal bazeh qedima, veyoter tob leharbot babberakot, kemo shennitbaer. Abal im haiqqar chabib alayv leolam yoter min hattapel — tzarik lebarek alayv techilla, shekkevan shehu chashub mimmennu umuqdam libraka mechamat chabibut atzmo velo mechamat birkato — rauy hu lebarek alayv veliptor hattapel bebirkato mechamat tepelato, shezzehu iqqar maalat chashibuto kesheppoter dabar acher bebirkato, velo qedima lebaddah, sheen bah maala kol kak laddebarim hachashubim mitztzad atzman, kemo shennitbaer besiman ry"a. Veap im birkat haiqqar hi "shehakkol" ubirkat hattapel hi meboreret uperatit — en zeh moil lehaqdimo, kevan shello haya okelo kelal im lo haiqqar. Vaapillu im akshav kesheokel hattapel im haiqqar hattapel chabib alayv yoter ella shekkesheokelo lebaddo eno chabib lo kemo haiqqar — en lo lebarek alayv kelal, kevan shekkeshebba leoklo lebaddo hare eno chabib alayv kemo haiqqar, ukeshebba leoklo im haiqqar hare hu tapel elayv, vekol iqqar vetapel ap al pi shehattapel chabib — mebarek al haiqqar upoter et hattapel hanneekal immo o acharayv:

Leolam en hattapel niptar bebirkat haiqqar, vaapillu im hem shene minim shebbirkotehem shavot, ella keshehaya hattapel lepanayv, o shehayeta dato alayv beberur beshaa shebberak al haiqqar, abal im achar habberaka hebiuhu lepanayv velo hayeta dato alayv beberur, beinyan sheim lo haya tapel haya tzarik lachazor ulebarek — en tepelato moelet kelum lepotro bebirkat haiqqar, lo mibberaka rishona ap al pi shebbirkotehem shavot, veal derek mah shennitbaer besiman r"v, velo mibberaka acharona kesheen birkotehem [haacharonot] shavot, ella im ken qaba atzmo al haiqqar, vehu dabar sheqqebiut moelet bo mippene sheddarko bekak, kegon pat, veken yayin, kemo shennitbaer besiman r"v, veken shekar udebash bimdinot ellu, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ry"g. Umikkol maqom, mi sheokel pat o maakal acher lematteq hashshetiyya vedarko bekak berob happeamim — hare zeh keillu hayeta dato alayv. Veim en darko bekak — mebarek al happat "shehakkol" kebirkat hammashqeh shehi tepela elayv. (Abal en tzarik littol yadayv techilla, ap im hu beinyan shetztzarik lebarek aleha "hammotzi", kegon shehi tepela ledabar sheen birkato "shehakkol", uleinyan netilat yadayim lo shayyak lechalleq ben im hayeta dato al hattapel bishat birkat haiqqar o shennimlak alayv achar habberaka, ella kevan sheokelah betorat tepela ledabar acher — patur minnetilat yadayim, shello tiqqenu lappat ella kesheokelah lisod halleb, shesseudatah regila umetzuya tamid, veyesh lachosh leserek teruma, kemo shennitbaer besiman qn"ch):

Vekol tepela hanneekelet achar akilat haiqqar enah nipteret bebirkato ella im ken okelah bammaqom sheakal haiqqar velo shinna meqomo benetayim mecheder lecheder, kemo shello hayeta nipteret im lo hayeta tepela, mippene sheamidato mimmeqomo hu gemar seudato, umah sheokel achar kak — seuda acheret hi, kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"ch. Ella im ken hi tepela ledabar hattaun beraka leacharayv bimqomo, sheaz en amidato gemar seudato kol shello berak beraka haacharona, kemo shennitbaer:
